junior-daily.angle: Where in the world and who is involved: follow Trump's route from Maryland to Manila and on to Shenzhen in China, and meet the leaders at each stop, from the Quad partners to Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.

breakfast-table.angle: What it means at home: why the leaders with the biggest nuclear arsenals meeting matters to every family, why officials expect only a start, and how a US-China trade truce ending in January touches what families buy.

current-affairs-digest.angle: The full picture: the week's summit calendar in Manila and Shenzhen, what ASEAN, the East Asia Summit, the Quad and APEC are, who attends, and what each side says to expect from the first US-China-Russia leaders' meeting.

global-citizen-plus.angle: Links to school subjects: the history behind fears of a new Yalta, the expired US-Russia nuclear arms treaty and China's position on its own arsenal, and the geography of Manila, Shenzhen and the South China Sea in between.

young-global-citizen.angle: What it means for families in the United States and India: the American president and the Indian prime minister are both in Manila, meeting as Quad partners, before Trump flies on to China for nuclear talks with Xi and Putin.

europe-explained.angle: How it reaches the UK and Europe: three leaders will meet in Shenzhen without Europe in the room; Trump says he will raise Ukraine, Zelenskyy warns against a new Yalta, and the EU insists a ceasefire must come first.
